title: National Servicemen Eligible for LifeSG Credits Announced in Budget 2024
what_it_is: National Servicemen Eligible for LifeSG Credits Announced in Budget 2024

sections.label: NSmen LifeSG credits disbursement
sections.summary: Over one million NSmen received $200 in LifeSG credits, with hard copy vouchers available on request from MINDEF and MHA.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: In the month of November, more than one million NSmen would have received, via the LifeSG application, $200 worth of credits which can be used to purchase a range of household and lifestyle goods and services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Twenty-six percent, or more than a quarter of a million, of the recipients are above 60 years old.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Recipients who need help to claim the credits can contact the NS Call Centre or approach the digital ambassadors at the 36 SG Digital Community Hubs and nine ServiceSG Centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Those who are unable to access the credits via the digital LifeSG mobile application or who are not comfortable with digital payments, may request the Ministry of Defence (MINDEF) and the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) for hard copy vouchers.

sections.label: Digital and hard copy options
sections.summary: The Member is assured both digital and hard copy options exist, with past take-up and support figures cited.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, I want to assure the Member again that there is no intention to divide those who are digitally savvy and those who are not, because you have both options – the digital and the hard copies that you can request from MHA and MINDEF.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But if the Member would like to have a sense, based on the last disbursement that we had with the LifeSG Credits in 2022, about 88% of eligible NSmen who were above 60 years old had utilised their credits, and just 2% of them requested and received hard copy vouchers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: I would hope that after one round of experience, maybe more would have a positive experience this round as well and would be used to the LifeSG app.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But overall, if we look at the survey that we had done in the last poll – this was just about four months after the last campaign or the last disbursement in 2022 – about 95% of our NSmen indicated that they were supportive of digital disbursements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: On the Member's other point about potential scams or attempts on use of PayNow payments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: If the Member has specific information on the WhatsApp messages, let us know, so that we can investigate and see if these are scams.
